name: url-shortener-add-expiration
requirement: Add optional link expiration to the existing generated URL-shortener service. A link may be created with an optional expires_at timestamp; an expired short code must return a 410 Gone instead of redirecting. Preserve all existing links, the existing redirect/health/analytics APIs and their current response shapes for links created without an expiration. Migrate the existing SQLite schema safely, without losing any existing link or click-count data, and add tests covering both pre-existing (never-expiring) links and newly created expiring links.
acceptance_criteria: A previously created link with no expiration continues to redirect exactly as before
A new link can be created with an expires_at timestamp in the future
Requesting an expired short code returns 410 Gone, not a redirect
The SQLite schema migration preserves every existing link row and its click count
Existing API response shapes for non-expiring links are unchanged
Analytics for an expired link still reports its historical click count
